mentions.name: daemoneye
mentions.description: A daemon for monitoring services and systems. Its memory management is being refactored to better support continuous operation over long time horizons, where the state of monitored services/things drifts and knowledge becomes stale.
mentions.problem: Over long time horizons, the state of monitored services/things drifts and knowledge becomes stale.
